# darun.io

> darun.io is a curated platform for discovering, evaluating, and comparing software tools and online services.

## Canonical Resources

- [Home (Korean)](https://www.darun.io/ko): Korean homepage with featured categories and popular services
- [Home (English)](https://www.darun.io/en): English homepage with featured categories and popular services
- [Rankings (Korean)](https://www.darun.io/ko/ranking): Most popular curated services ranked by community votes
- [Rankings (English)](https://www.darun.io/en/ranking): Most popular curated services ranked by community votes
- [About & Editorial Policy (Korean)](https://www.darun.io/ko/about): About Darun, transparency, and curation principles
- [About & Editorial Policy (English)](https://www.darun.io/en/about): About Darun, transparency, and curation principles
- [Sitemap](https://www.darun.io/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable inventory of all indexable canonical URLs

## Content Negotiation (AcceptMarkdown)

All public document URLs on darun.io support HTTP Content Negotiation via the Accept header:
- `Accept: text/markdown`: Returns clean, semantic Markdown representations without UI chrome or scripts.
- `Accept: text/html`: Returns standard responsive web application HTML.
- Explicit `.md` sibling URLs are available for direct compatibility, e.g. `https://www.darun.io/ko/products/{slug}.md`.
